div.div: مُزَبْرَجٌ Embellished, adorned, or decorated: applied as an epithet to زِبْرِجٌ [either in the first or second of the senses expl. above, as is indicated in the S; and also as meaning clouds, as is likewise indicated in the S: in each case merely heightening the signification]. (S, K.) You say also سَحَابٌ مُزَبْرَجٌ [app. meaning Variegated clouds]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
